findings.reason: The static feminine-plural verb हैं agrees with the shown count, but hi CLDR `one` covers 0 and 1 (the binding style guide states "0 फ़ाइल" is singular), so the common one-chat state renders the ungrammatical "कुल 1 चैट में से 1 दिखाई जा रही हैं"; the same disagreement appears at 0. A plural on the already-present shown argument fixes only the 0/1 arm and leaves 2+ unchanged.
